name: Schema Markup for Medical Business
author: Federico Jauregui Sanchez

sections.description:
Schema Markup for Medical Business is a vertical schema plugin for medical businesses.

Project website: https://www.prmedica-inc.com/
Look at a demo on a Regenerative Medicine clinic: Demo Regenerative Medicine Schema

It helps clinics, solo practices, dentists and labs publish useful JSON-LD without touching code. The plugin focuses on:

  • Business home schema for medical practices.
  • Location pages for clinics, labs and dental offices.
  • Individual practitioner profile pages using ProfilePage + Person.
  • Service pages and optional medical content classification.
  • FAQ schema only when the FAQ content is visible and verifiable.
  • Defensive coexistence with Yoast, Rank Math and AIOSEO.
  • Diagnostics for missing data, risky configuration and graph previews.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to /wp-content/plugins/.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins screen in WordPress.
  3. Open Medical Schema in the admin menu.
  4. Complete Business Settings.
  5. Link locations, practitioners and services to their public pages.
sections.faq:
Does this guarantee rich results?

No. The plugin outputs valid schema where possible, but Google decides which rich results to show.

Does it replace my SEO plugin?

No. The plugin uses a defensive coexistence mode alongside supported SEO plugins.

Does it support Elementor?

Yes, passively. The schema output works on Elementor-built pages, but v1 does not add custom Elementor widgets.

Where can I get support?

Once the plugin is published, use the WordPress.org support forum for this plugin. Project website: https://www.prmedica-inc.com/
